name: Hello Device
author: rrrtx
description: First physical-world capability pack (DF-05 proposal). Treats device pins as CapabilityDescriptors behind a driver adapter seam. Simulated board by default; actuation is risk-tiered (observe/reversible/irreversible), approval-gated, and recorded to XR's tamper-evident audit chain. Hardware-unverified: see PACK_PROPOSAL.md.

capabilities.name: probe
capabilities.description: Probe the active device driver and print the pin map.

capabilities.name: status
capabilities.description: Driver probe result, board pin map, and device-journal summary.

capabilities.name: read
capabilities.description: Read an input/sensor pin (observe tier). Never actuates.

capabilities.name: write
capabilities.description: Write an output pin (approval-gated; irreversible class requires explicit confirm).

capabilities.name: blink
capabilities.description: Blink a reversible output pin N times (approval-gated).

capabilities.name: select_driver
capabilities.description: Switch the device driver adapter value (approval-gated). LAW 17: drivers are values, not architecture.

capabilities.name: journal
capabilities.description: Read the hash-chained device action journal (evidence artifact, read-only).
